# F3 (dc-728): the dynamic-array functions and the LAMBDA helpers, each array result read whole
# through CONCAT (so one cell shows every element), written in file form.
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.SEQUENCE(2,3))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.SEQUENCE(3,1,10,-2))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn._xlws.FILTER(Data!A1:A3,Data!A1:A3>1))
_xlfn._xlws.FILTER(Data!A1:A3,Data!A1:A3>9,"none")
_xlfn._xlws.FILTER(Data!A1:A3,Data!A1:A3>9)
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn._xlws.SORT(Data!A1:A3))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn._xlws.SORT(Data!A1:A3,,-1))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn._xlws.SORT(Data!B1:B3))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn._xlws.SORT({"b";"A";"c"}))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn._xlws.SORT(Data!A1:A4))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn._xlws.SORT(Data!A1:A4,,-1))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn._xlws.SORT({1,"b";2,"a"},2))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn._xlws.SORT({TRUE;"x";2;#N/A}))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.SORTBY({"a";"b";"c"},{3;1;2}))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.UNIQUE(Data!B1:B3))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.UNIQUE({"a";"A";"b"}))
ROWS(_xlfn.UNIQUE(_xlfn.VSTACK(0.3,0.1+0.2)))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.UNIQUE({1;2;1;3},,TRUE))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.TAKE({1,2;3,4;5,6},-2,1))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.DROP({1,2;3,4;5,6},1,1))
_xlfn.DROP({1,2},1)
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.CHOOSEROWS({1,2;3,4;5,6},3,1))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.CHOOSECOLS({1,2,3},{3,1}))
_xlfn.CHOOSECOLS({1,2,3},4)
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.VSTACK({1,2},{3,4}))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.HSTACK(Data!A1:A2,Data!E1:E2))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.TOCOL({1,2;3,4},,TRUE))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.TOROW(Data!A1:A4,1))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.WRAPROWS({1,2,3,4,5},2,0))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.WRAPCOLS({1,2,3},2,0))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.EXPAND({1,2},2,3,0))
_xlfn.EXPAND({1,2},1,1)
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.MAP({1,2,3},_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.x,_xlpm.x*2)))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.MAP({1,2},{10,20},_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.a,_xlpm.b,_xlpm.a+_xlpm.b)))
_xlfn.REDUCE(0,Data!A1:A3,_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.a,_xlpm.b,_xlpm.a+_xlpm.b))
_xlfn.REDUCE("",{"a","b"},_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.acc,_xlpm.x,_xlpm.acc&_xlpm.x))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.SCAN(0,{1,2,3},_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.a,_xlpm.b,_xlpm.a+_xlpm.b)))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.BYROW({1,2;3,4},_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.r,SUM(_xlpm.r))))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.BYCOL({1,2;3,4},_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.c,MAX(_xlpm.c))))
_xlfn.CONCAT(_xlfn.MAKEARRAY(2,2,_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.r,_xlpm.c,_xlpm.r*10+_xlpm.c)))
_xlfn.MAP({1,2},_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.x,{1,2}))
_xlfn.MAP({1,2},5)
_xlfn.MAP({1,2},_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.x,_xlpm.y,_xlpm.x))
_xlfn.MAKEARRAY(0,1,_xlfn.LAMBDA(_xlpm.r,_xlpm.c,1))
